comparison.objective: Open a bottle and pour its contents into a cup; candidate finishes installed thread inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bottle stabilization, cap turning or flip-lid actuation, regrasping, and controlled pouring versus mandrel alignment, hammering, and tiny rigid-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle opened and at least 80% transferred without moving or tipping the cup or breaking anything versus four tangs fractured and contained with inserts and shell intact.
comparison.reason: The central mechanisms and outcomes—opening and bulk transfer versus controlled notch fracture and debris accounting—are different.
